Rock Band SCANDAL Announces Disbandment After 21 Years
The official website of SCANDAL announced on Monday that the four-member all-female rock band will disband on August 21, 2027, following their final concert at the Yokohama Arena in Kanagawa Prefecture. The disbandment date will coincide with the band's 21st anniversary. The band explained that after reaching their 20th anniversary, they held numerous discussions and felt they had fully accomplished everything they could do together as a four-member group. 'Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori' Announces Additional Cast Pair, Second Cour for Fall 2026
The official website of the Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori (Red River) television anime revealed two additional cast members on Monday. The anime series adapting Chie Shinohara's adventure fantasy manga is currently airing with a second cour scheduled to begin on September 29 at 1:35 a.m. on NTV's AnichU programming block, followed by BS-NTV.
